propositions: Every newly certified plan review must emit deterministic, canonicalized pins binding to direct children and prerequisites without adding ticket fields or user commands.

PlanRelationSnapshot must preload all ticket states store-wide to discover archived inbound blockers, resolve aliases/prefixes before deduplication, and emit one pin per canonical ID and role in deterministic order.
Pin collection must run before prerequisite LLM evaluation; any unreadable or unresolvable target must return unsigned INDETERMINATE with structured PlanRelationSnapshotError before LLM invocation.

tracker_head_sha() must verify clean tickets-tracker state using git status/ls-files and return clean 40-hex HEAD SHA; dirty/unmerged/subprocess/IO/malformed output failures map to store-read-failure.

All plan-review signing paths (sign_plan_review, refresh_attestation, resign_plan_review) must call collect_plan_relation_snapshot and pass related_material to build_manifest; deleted targets prevent refresh/re-sign until relationship repair.
Legacy manifests without pins must remain parseable and authenticatable by readers that ignore unknown pin lines without reconstruction or rehashing.
